name: routines-ledger-dark
js: (async () => { const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const byLabel = (l) => document.querySelector(`[aria-label="${l}"]`) || [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => (b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').startsWith(l)); byLabel('Scheduled, collapsed')?.click(); await wait(250); byLabel('Routines')?.click(); await wait(1200); const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('.rtrow')].find((r) => (r.textContent || '').includes('neuramesh-ai/neuramesh-oss')); row?.querySelector('button[aria-expanded]')?.click(); await wait(1100); })()
